name: High Protein Oats Filter Kappi
ingredients_raw: INSTANT OATS (44.7%), PROTEIN SOURCE BLEND (28.6% ) (TEXTURED SOY PROTEIN FLAKES, SOY PROTEIN ISOLATE, WHEY POWDER), DEHYDRATED FRUITS, SEEDS (12%) (RAISINS, CHIA SEEDS, SUNFLOWER SEEDS, PUMPKIN SEEDS), FRUCTO-OLIGOSACCHARIDE, COFFEE POWDER (3.4%), RICE BRAN OIL, HIMALAYAN PINK SALT, NATURAL FLAVOURS, PROBIOTICS (BACILLUS COAGULANS SNZ 1969, 15 BILLION CFU/g), SWEETENER (STEVIOL GLYCOSIDES).
